craft_notes: Sthāyin: sealing with the maker's name (colophon joy). Sanskrit: stavacintāmaṇim (accusative object, the jewel made) + bhūrimanorathaphalapradam + bhaktilakṣmyālayaṃ + śambho (vocative dedication) + bhaṭṭanārāyaṇo vyadhāt (maker acts, aorist — done). Feel: weight held across three epithets, then the signature falls. Device: comma line 1 (heaping held), dash line 2 (wright released). Rejected: 'made' for 'wrought' — killed: vyadhāt is wrought-fashioned, weightier; shortening the name — killed: colophon names whole, kept whole. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: This laud-gem, gravid with granted longings, luck's lodging of love —
for Śambhu wrought Nārāyaṇa the Preceptor.
l4.sanskrit_cite: stavacintāmaṇiṃ bhūrimanorathaphalapradam bhaktilakṣmyālayaṃ śambho bhaṭṭanārāyaṇo vyadhāt
